single_locality_states.description: States currently represented by exactly one locality record — every state added this marathon plus several earlier pilot/expansion states. All of these are candidates for depth expansion (a second AHJ) once national breadth work concludes.

next_depth_priority_ranking.methodology: Zero-READY states ranked by approximate state population (a proxy for verified-population-coverage-per-research-hour potential) — flipping a large, currently zero-READY state to its first READY record has outsized product value versus adding a second locality to an already-published state.
